text:
I only buy a McDonalds once a year just to see if the quality had gotten better or at least back to how it once was and it's no surprise that's it's gotten worse.

- Quarter Pounder with Cheese: Burger meat was dry and burnt, the onion tasted raw, the ketchup and mustard was caked on, probably to try to cover up the burnt burger taste (it didn't work)
- Double cheese burger: so much sauce it was dripping out the bun, more sauce than anything else and even worse more mustard than ketchup, barely any onions, a sprinkle at best.

Fries were hot, I was shocked. I thought they was light at the end of this dark depressing meal, however turns out every single fry was caked in salt. Overly salted to the point it was unbearable to even eat them. Couldn't even eat them.

Milkshake was the only good part but you have to have a better suction rate that a Dyson vacuum because it's like sucking up ice-cream through a tiny, quickly disintegrating straw

Thanks for reminding me what utter trash fast food in the UK is and why I don't bother with this places anymore. Go support your local independent restaurants, you will pay same price or a tiny bit more and get good quality, fresh tasty food and won't feel like you will have a health condition after eating it.

McDonald's is an absolute shambles
author: Joshua

text: if i could, i would put 0 stars but i cant. me and 3 other friends waited 2 HOURS for a burger and fries each and they cancelled one of our orders and when we asked where the food was, all we got back was “it’s in the kitchen being made” which is absolutely ridiculous. the bathrooms are genuinely disgusting and there was opened and used feminine hygiene products on the floor, it stunk of waste and there was faeces smeared on the walls in one of the stalls. a child came out the stall carrying a used tampon they had found on the floor and this is a hazard in so many ways. It was absolutely jam packed with people and the upstairs was closed off. there was crying kids screaming and running around everywhere and the floor was covered in rubbish. once one of my friends got their food, it was cold, soggy, and had a pube in it, never mind the fact she only got the fries and drink and not the rest of her meal. me and one of my friends went up to the counter to cancel our order because the waiting time was appalling and some old woman with a beard shoulder barged my friend to get to the front. i am absolutely fuming and i am never coming hear again. 🤬
author: Abbey Blackhall

text: Last time I ever go back in there. A pigeon kept coming through the door and it was everywhere. This place needs to do something to prevent pigeons coming in the door and being where food is being eaten by people. I had to hurry to eat what I had ordered and take the rest out to finish even though I had paid to eat in. There are ways of keeping out pigeons so why hasn't this place put anything in place to stop them. Also people just queueing anywhere and everywhere because they can't be bothered to queue up properly,, but most people should know how to form a queue in this country because it's what people do so often, don't just stand anywhere, fgs get in a proper queue so people can also get past after they have collected their order.
author: E T

text:
The worst McDonald’s experience I’ve ever had.
Our order took 32 minutes to be ready. Because the kitchen was faster than the serving counter, all the food ended up cold by the time we got it. The fries were completely inedible. The milkshake was the wrong flavor (strawberry instead of vanilla), and when we unpacked the bag, one hamburger was missing. To make things worse, they had run out of sauce for the fries, and the tables were so dirty that cola was dripping off some of them.

None of this is exaggerated , it was truly a disappointing experience. I won’t be visiting McDonald’s again anytime soon.

Despite everything, the staff remained very patient and helpful.
author: Kevin Hesp

text: The worst McDonald experience I ever had. We had to wait more than 35 minutes before we got our order. The fries were cold, a hamburger was missing and one of our milkshakes was the wrong flavour. On top of all this, the place was dirty and not cleaned. Rubbish bins poured over. And one of the sauces to go with the fries, was gone. They just couldn’t handle the crowd. Fortunately, when we went back for the missing burger and the wrong flavor of milkshake, we were helped quickly and friendly. I think the staff works hard, but something has to be done to that place to smoothen the processes.
author: Kevin en Annelieke

text:
I would like to share my concerns about the atmosphere at this branch. I experience the environment as quite negative.
Some employees behave aggressively and do not communicate in a normal or respectful way. At times, it feels unprofessional, as if certain individuals are trying to act like they are in charge instead of working together as a team.

I believe a professional and respectful work environment is important, and unfortunately, that is not how I currently experience it.

I hope this can be taken seriously and addressed appropriately.
author: Bakar

text: I waited over 999 seconds for my order, only to receive cold food. The fries had been sitting in the fry station for 10 minutes, making them stale. On top of that, the bouncers—especially the head bouncer—were unnecessarily aggressive and seemed to be on a complete power trip. The overall experience was terrible. I wouldn’t recommend coming here. I and many other friends have experienced exceptionally poor behaviour from the individual in the attached images for many months.
author: Sebastian Hughes

text:
Racist against white people.
The lady placed my order on the counter as I came to collect.
then said nothing and walked away, I wasnt sure if it were my order or if they went to get mine... I peered into the bag it was my order. she didnt even look at me, no words, no napkin placed in the bag.

First time I've experienced micro aggression in my life. it wasn't busy btw it was about 11:30pm on a tuesday, only about 5 people waiting to collect orders.
author: L H

text: I went with 2 friends and my neice and they got all the orders correct and warm except mine, I sent back a wrong, but hot order and got a cold, sloppily made burger in return, while my friends orders were warm and made correctly. We received no straws and on one friends burger they had put pickles on and then removed them.
author: Denni Kane
